patterns.prevention:
• **Screen coaches before placement** – Assess engagement level and teaching style during interviews; only assign coaches who match or exceed the centre's expectations based on previous instructor quality.

• **Communicate coach transitions upfront** – Inform centres immediately when a coach is temporary or transitioning; provide replacement timeline and introduce new coach before handover.

• **Monitor attendance and energy** – Track no-shows and coach engagement in first 4 sessions; pull coaches with low participation rates and reallocate before centres cancel.

• **Maintain backup coach availability** – Keep at least one trained substitute ready so centres aren't forced to choose between a poor-fit coach and programme cancellation.
